# What this notebook does

Kate, 2026-10-29: Hallmark and KEGG over-representation analysis (ORA) of the `r params$k` SHAP
clusters of the `r params$set_word` shown in `26d_target_cluster_feature_importance.Rmd`'s
top-feature heatmaps (`r params$profile` SHAP profile, k = `r params$k`). The clusters are read
from `26b_target_subtypes_features.Rmd`'s saved CSV, not re-derived.

The method is `27_ora_shap_groups.Rmd`'s, unchanged: `clusterProfiler::enricher` on gene symbols,
msigdbr Hallmark (`category = "H"`) and KEGG (C2 sets whose subcategory contains "KEGG", i.e.
`CP:KEGG_LEGACY` and `CP:KEGG_MEDICUS`), FDR, gene-set size `r params$min_gs`-`r params$max_gs`,
significant at adjusted p < `r params$padj_cut`.

**Universe: all modelled genes** (the genes the SHAP forest explained), so each cluster is asked
what it carries relative to the transcriptome (Kate, 2026-10-29). A pathway enriched in every
cluster is therefore likely a property of the target set as a whole, not of any one cluster.

```{r libraries}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(tidyverse); library(here); library(msigdbr); library(clusterProfiler); library(pheatmap); library(grid) })
O <- here("output", "translational_control_overview")
SAVE <- isTRUE(params$save_plots)
K <- as.integer(params$k)
ptag <- sub("_lfc.*$", "", sub("^eif33d_promotes_", "", params$suffix))
ftag <- paste0(ptag, "_", gsub("[ ,]+", "_", params$profile), "_k", K)
```

# 1. Gene sets

```{r gene_sets}
hallmark <- suppressWarnings(msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H")) %>% dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol)
c2 <- suppressWarnings(msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C2"))
kegg <- c2 %>% filter(grepl("KEGG", gs_subcat, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>% dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol)
cat("msigdbr", as.character(packageVersion("msigdbr")), "| Hallmark sets:", n_distinct(hallmark$gs_name),
    "| KEGG sets:", n_distinct(kegg$gs_name), "from", paste(unique(c2$gs_subcat[grepl("KEGG", c2$gs_subcat)]), collapse = " + "), "\n")
stopifnot("Hallmark should have 50 sets" = n_distinct(hallmark$gs_name) == 50, "no KEGG sets found" = nrow(kegg) > 0)
collections <- list(Hallmark = hallmark, KEGG = kegg)
```

# 2. The clusters

```{r clusters}
oof <- readRDS(file.path(O, paste0("shap_oof_", params$suffix, ".rds")))
all_genes <- oof$genes
tg <- all_genes %>% filter(set == params$set_label)
a <- read_csv(file.path(O, paste0("target_shap_feature_clusters_", params$suffix, ".csv")), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(profile == params$profile, k == K)
stopifnot("clustering missing from 26b_'s CSV - knit 26b_ with this profile and k" = nrow(a) > 0,
          "clusters do not cover exactly the targets" = setequal(a$gene_id_clean, tg$gene_id_clean),
          "a gene is in more than one cluster" = !anyDuplicated(a$gene_id_clean),
          "cluster labels are not 1..k" = setequal(a$cluster, seq_len(K)),
          "modelled genes are not unique" = !anyDuplicated(all_genes$gene_id_clean))
sym <- setNames(all_genes$symbol, all_genes$gene_id_clean)
cat(sprintf("%d %s of %d modelled genes | %s, k = %d | cluster sizes %s | %d modelled genes without a symbol\n",
            nrow(tg), params$set_word, nrow(all_genes), params$profile, K,
            paste(table(a$cluster), collapse = " / "), sum(is.na(sym))))
universes <- list(`all modelled genes` = all_genes$gene_id_clean)
groups <- setNames(lapply(seq_len(K), function(g) a$gene_id_clean[a$cluster == g]), paste("cluster", seq_len(K)))
```

# 3. ORA

```{r ora}
run_one <- function(ids, group, universe_is, coll_name) {
  g <- unique(na.omit(sym[ids])); u <- unique(na.omit(sym[universes[[universe_is]]]))
  r <- tryCatch(enricher(gene = g, universe = u, TERM2GENE = collections[[coll_name]], pAdjustMethod = "fdr",
                         pvalueCutoff = 1, qvalueCutoff = 1, minGSSize = params$min_gs, maxGSSize = params$max_gs),
                error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(r) || !nrow(r@result)) return(NULL)
  r@result %>% as_tibble() %>%
    transmute(collection = coll_name, universe_is, group, n_group = length(ids),
              pathway = ID, GeneRatio, BgRatio, Count, pvalue, p.adjust,
              # (k / n) / (M / N): both denominators count only genes annotated in this collection,
              # exactly as clusterProfiler's GeneRatio and BgRatio do.
              fold_enrichment = (as.numeric(sub("/.*", "", GeneRatio)) / as.numeric(sub(".*/", "", GeneRatio))) /
                                (as.numeric(sub("/.*", "", BgRatio)) / as.numeric(sub(".*/", "", BgRatio))),
              genes = geneID)
}
ora <- crossing(collection = names(collections), universe_is = names(universes), group = names(groups)) %>%
  pmap_dfr(function(collection, universe_is, group) run_one(groups[[group]], group, universe_is, collection))
stopifnot("ORA returned nothing" = nrow(ora) > 0, "fold enrichment not finite" = all(is.finite(ora$fold_enrichment)))
sig <- ora %>% filter(p.adjust < params$padj_cut)
ora %>% group_by(collection, universe_is, group) %>% summarise(tested = n(), significant = sum(p.adjust < params$padj_cut), .groups = "drop") %>%
  knitr::kable()
if (SAVE) write_csv(ora, file.path(O, paste0("ora_target_clusters_hallmark_kegg_", ftag, ".csv")))
```

## Significant pathways

```{r sig_table}
if (nrow(sig)) {
  sig %>% arrange(collection, universe_is, group, p.adjust) %>%
    transmute(collection, universe_is, group, pathway, GeneRatio, BgRatio, fold_enrichment = round(fold_enrichment, 2),
              p.adjust = signif(p.adjust, 2)) %>% knitr::kable()
} else cat("No pathway reaches adjusted p <", params$padj_cut, "in any cluster, collection or universe.\n")
```

# 4. Figures

One heatmap per universe and collection: fold enrichment for every pathway significant in at
least one cluster, `*` where adjusted p < `r params$padj_cut`. A blank cell means the pathway had
no genes in that cluster (fold enrichment 0).

```{r heatmaps, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 7, results = "asis"}
for (ui in names(universes)) for (cn in names(collections)) {
  d <- ora %>% filter(universe_is == ui, collection == cn)
  sp <- d %>% filter(p.adjust < params$padj_cut) %>% pull(pathway) %>% unique()
  if (!length(sp)) { cat("\n\n**", cn, ", universe ", ui, ":** no significant pathways\n", sep = ""); next }
  W <- d %>% filter(pathway %in% sp) %>% dplyr::select(pathway, group, fold_enrichment) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = fold_enrichment, values_fill = 0) %>% column_to_rownames("pathway")
  for (cc in setdiff(names(groups), colnames(W))) W[[cc]] <- 0
  W <- as.matrix(W[, names(groups), drop = FALSE])
  S <- d %>% filter(pathway %in% sp) %>% mutate(s = ifelse(p.adjust < params$padj_cut, "*", "")) %>%
    dplyr::select(pathway, group, s) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = s, values_fill = "") %>% column_to_rownames("pathway")
  for (cc in setdiff(names(groups), colnames(S))) S[[cc]] <- ""
  S <- as.matrix(S[rownames(W), names(groups), drop = FALSE])
  colnames(W) <- paste0(names(groups), " (n = ", lengths(groups), ")")
  hm <- pheatmap(W, cluster_rows = nrow(W) > 2, cluster_cols = FALSE, color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#F4B183", "#D55E00"))(100),
                 breaks = seq(0, max(W, 1), length.out = 101), display_numbers = S, number_color = "black", fontsize_number = 11,
                 fontsize_row = 7, angle_col = 45, cellwidth = 34,
                 main = sprintf("%s %s, %s SHAP clusters (k = %d): %s ORA\nfold enrichment; * adjusted p < %.2f; universe: %s (n = %s)",
                                params$label, params$set_word, sub("features, ", "", params$profile), K, cn,
                                params$padj_cut, ui, scales::comma(length(universes[[ui]]))), silent = TRUE)
  cat("\n\n## ", cn, ", universe: ", ui, "\n\n", sep = ""); grid.newpage(); grid.draw(hm$gtable)
  if (SAVE) {
    f <- here("plots", paste0("26e_ora_", tolower(cn), "_", ftag, "_universe_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", ui), ".pdf"))
    pdf(f, width = 9, height = 2.5 + 0.17 * nrow(W)); grid.newpage(); grid.draw(hm$gtable); dev.off() }
}
```
